simple.meaning: קֶשֶׁת (qesheth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bow , for shooting (hence, figuratively, strength ) or the iris.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 76 times across Genesis, Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 9:13. Its contexts include family, family line, covenant.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶשֶׁת (H7198).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קֶשֶׁת (qesheth) / H7198 is traced through Genesis 9:13, Genesis 9:14, Genesis 9:16, Genesis 21:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.
